records.title: CN1 EggplantQueen
records.body: CN1 is the adult stylized Eggplant Queen character connecting community, games, social spaces and Telegram tooling. The public repository is a presentation home, not the private production code.

records.title: CN1 the CLUB
records.body: The public STATUS page describes the CLUB as live and evolving: a CN1 online social and music space. Live/evolving does not mean every experimental room, game or new feature is released.

records.title: CN1 BAD DECISIONS
records.body: The public STATUS document lists BAD DECISIONS as an experimental arcade experience. It does not independently establish which chapters or game builds are publicly available.

records.title: Lower Rooms
records.body: The public status reports ongoing combat and multiplayer development; movement repetition and aiming/targeting behavior were listed as known rough edges. Do not claim these were fixed without a newer verified report.

records.title: CN1 public Telegram bots
records.body: The public status identifies EggplantQueenBot as a live Telegram community interaction bot. NEX is a separate laboratory assistant and cannot control that bot or members' gameplay by merely answering messages.

records.title: CN1 3D character
records.body: The public roadmap describes a reusable 3D CN1 character foundation for games, the CLUB and future content. It remains a development direction rather than a published universal avatar system.

records.title: Eggplant Slots
records.body: The public README describes Eggplant Slots as an active CN1 game project. That description alone is not a current runtime or payout verification; availability should be checked through official game surfaces.

records.title: CN1 Comics and Sunday stories
records.body: The public roadmap includes comics and visual storytelling among later possibilities for CN1. A roadmap direction is not evidence that a particular episode is published.
